speaker: johan_vosloo
headline: ORDER DEPENDS ON A VISIBLE CHAIN OF AUTHORITY.
deck: Public confidence rises when rules, responsibility, enforcement and disclosure line up.
quote: A state earns trust when authority is clear, bounded and accountable.
facts: Rules must define who is responsible.
Authority must be traceable to an institution.
Enforcement should be proportionate and predictable.
takeaway: Institutional order is strongest when power is visible, limited and answerable.
